Name: Timescale Display
Author: thebeardphantom
Description:
My first Stardew mod! Displays the current time scale as a multiplier (i.e. 2.0x) on the time-of-day display.

Highly configurable via the Generic Mod Config Menu [i](Configuration menu will not display without GMCM and GMCM Options installed)[/i].

[url=https://github.com/thebeardphantom/Stardew-Mods/tree/main/TimescaleDisplay]Source code is available here.[/url]

Downloads.Description:
• Added option to render timescale above/below vanilla HUD.
• Updated manifest to require min SMAPI version 4.1.0.
• Fixed bugs related to timescale showing when it shouldn't (events/cutscenes, screenshots, festivals, etc)
